subject: Life Orientation
assessment_title: Life Orientation Grade 12 Term 2 Controlled Assessment Pack

visual_blueprint.subject: Life Orientation
assessment_content_focus: rights, responsibilities, community participation and media influence
portfolio or project response with rubric-marked reflection
generation_constraints: Every question must be answerable from the stated term focus, supplied stimulus and grade-appropriate subject knowledge.
Educator approval is required before classroom use.

sections.title: Section A: Scenario Analysis
sections.instructions: Use the scenario and respond with practical judgement.
sections.stimulus: Scenario: A Grade 12 learner faces choices linked to social and environmental responsibility.

questions.question: Identify the main issue in the scenario and explain why it matters.
Discuss TWO possible consequences of an unhealthy or irresponsible choice.
Recommend TWO support strategies and justify each one.

sections.title: Section B: Decision And Reflection
sections.stimulus: Reflection focus: case-study decision-making and evidence-based recommendation.

questions.question: Evaluate a responsible decision using evidence from the scenario.
Create a brief action plan with three safe, realistic steps.

sections.title: Section C: Portfolio Evidence
sections.stimulus: Portfolio focus: portfolio or project response with rubric-marked reflection.

questions.question: Complete a portfolio entry showing what evidence an educator can assess.

rubric.descriptor: Answers are clear, complete and structured.

teacher_review_checklist: Confirm CAPS term and topic fit before classroom use.
Insert or approve final source material where the pack requests educator-supplied sources.
Check mark allocation, memo wording and learner level.
Confirm visuals are suitable and not treated as official source material unless sourced separately.
